notes.en:
## New Features

- Redesign the sidebar: brand, search and New session at the top, one-line session rows with a hover details card, tinted folder cards replacing workspace groups and directory mode, drag tabs across the pin divider to pin or unpin, and a collapsed rail that keeps session icons and slides open on hover or Ctrl+Up/Down.
- Drop the desktop and phone header rows: the session page headers and workspace toolbar now act as the window title bar, and the version and quick actions sit beside the brand.
- Add outline Ask questions with grouped answers in the inbox, an outline task board (board UI, status bar and project task view), /goal for outline sessions, and task-change notifications.
- Rework outline plan mode into a plan tree with side-by-side approval, resume from the first startable step, and plan review that leaves comments and escalates concerns to human approval.
- Outline tool cards now describe what each step changed, with titled links, status chips and answer hints; outline icons no longer use text characters.
- Show a startup status page on the service port while starting, and report startup failures with a reason and a copyable command.
- Stream large attachments through staged uploads, raising the single-file limit to 1 GiB.
- Replace the blocking terminal wait_for with background terminal watches.
- Allow CreateWorktree to switch into the new worktree in the same call.
- Show output speed (tok/s) in usage, and surface unread sessions on the dashboard.
- Markdown preview in the file editor jumps to line references and keeps the reading position across modes.

## Improvements

- On Windows, use Win32 APIs for process identity and a Job Object to clean up child processes on exit, removing startup port reclamation and the wmic dependency.
- Outline typography follows the conversation; line height is rescaled so the previous 120% is the new 100%.
- Reopen the prefix epoch when the protocol changes or declarations cannot be appended, instead of requiring compaction.
- The search page has its own search box; Ctrl+` starts a new session.

## Fixes

- Thinking-exhausted truncations no longer trigger blind continuation.
- Reject forged upload references, authorize narrator image reads, stop public caching, and bound reference lookups so they do not stall the event loop.
- Restore Chinese attachment filenames and release staged uploads only after the message is queued.
- Preserve conversation identity after no-op edit reverts, and stop leaving sent messages in the draft after switching narrators.
- Register a new logical run when restarting a finished background subagent.
- Allow legacy sessions without a directory to restore their working directory.
- Fix several sidebar, GenUI input, file-editor and outline layout issues.

## Upgrade Notes

- This version is published to the beta / prerelease channel and continues to use executor-v0.9.5 and helpers-v1.0.0.
- Database migrations are included (outline task board, questions, line-height v2, recent-tab folders, request decode time). Back up your database before upgrading.
- Workspace groups and directory mode in the sidebar are replaced by folders.
notes.zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 侧边栏重新设计：顶部放置品牌、搜索与新建会话；会话行改为单行并带悬停详情卡；以着色文件夹卡片取代工作区分组与目录模式；可拖动标签跨过置顶分隔线来置顶或取消置顶；折叠时保留会话图标，悬停或 Ctrl+Up/Down 时滑出展开。
- 去掉桌面端与手机端的页头行：会话页标题栏和工作区工具栏直接充当窗口标题栏，版本号与快捷操作移到品牌旁。
- 大纲新增 Ask 提问并在收件箱成组回答、任务看板（看板界面、状态栏与项目页任务视图）、大纲会话的 /goal，以及改任务通知。
- 大纲计划模式改为计划树，支持对比审批、批准后从第一个可开始的步骤续跑；计划审查改为留意见，有疑问时转人工审批。
- 大纲工具卡说明每一步做了什么，带标题链接、状态 chip 与回答提示；大纲中的图标不再使用字符。
- 启动期间在服务端口显示启动状态页，启动失败时统一给出原因和可复制的命令。
- 大文件附件改为流式暂存上传，单文件上限放宽到 1 GiB。
- 用后台终端监听取代阻塞式 wait_for。
- CreateWorktree 可在同一次调用中切换到新 worktree。
- 用量中显示输出速度（tok/s），仪表盘展示未读会话。
- 文件编辑器的 Markdown 预览可跳转到行引用，并在模式切换时保持阅读位置。

## 改进

- Windows 上进程身份改用 Win32 API，退出时用 Job Object 清理子进程，去掉启动时的端口回收，不再依赖 wmic。
- 大纲沿用对话的排版数值；行距以原 120% 为新 100%。
- 协议变化或无法追加声明时重开前缀纪元，不再要求压缩。
- 搜索页有独立搜索框；Ctrl+` 新建会话。

## 修复

- 思考耗尽型截断不再盲目续跑。
- 拒绝伪造的上传引用，叙述者图片读取需授权并停止公开缓存，引用查找设置上限，避免阻塞事件循环。
- 还原中文附件文件名，消息入队后才释放暂存文件。
- 无改动的编辑回退后保持会话身份；切换叙述者后不再把已发出的消息留在草稿里。
- 重启已结束的后台子代理时注册新的 logical run。
- 允许无目录的旧会话恢复工作目录。
- 修复侧边栏、GenUI 输入、文件编辑器与大纲排版的多处问题。

## 升级说明

- 本版本发布到 beta / prerelease 通道，继续依赖 executor-v0.9.5 与 helpers-v1.0.0。
- 本次包含数据库迁移（大纲任务看板、提问、行距 v2、最近标签文件夹、请求解码耗时），升级前请备份数据库。
- 侧边栏的工作区分组与目录模式已由文件夹取代。
